justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/asm/AsmVisitorWrapper.java and repo-wide references in MemberSubstitution.java, Advice.java, MemberAttributeExtension.java, AccessControllerPlugin.java, and the AsmVisitorWrapper tests. The only Entry types are the two nested helper classes inside AsmVisitorWrapper (lines 206/247 and 448/539), and they are used only by their enclosing file; external code uses ForDeclaredFields/ForDeclaredMethods or their wrapper interfaces, not Entry directly. Their fan-out is narrow (matcher plus wrapper list plus ASM visitor types), so there is no evidence of hub-like modularization.
